fun.commands:
Commands

  • /fun: Play with the magic 8-ball, would you rather, truth or dare, hugs and high-fives.
    • 8ball button: Ask the magic 8-ball a yes-or-no question and get its answer.
    • Would you rather button: Post a would-you-rather question that everyone can vote on.
    • Truth or dare button: Get a truth or a dare. Press the buttons to keep the game going.
    • Hug button: Give another member a hug. They can hug you back.
    • High five button: Give another member a high-five. They can high-five you back.
    • Pat button: Pat another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Kiss button: Kiss another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Slap button: Slap another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Cuddle button: Cuddle another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Poke button: Poke another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Bite button: Bite another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Tickle button: Tickle another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Feed button: Feed another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Handhold button: Handhold another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Punch button: Punch another member, with an anime GIF.
    • Wave button: Wave, on your own or with someone, with an anime GIF.
    • Cry button: Cry, on your own or with someone, with an anime GIF.
    • Dance button: Dance, on your own or with someone, with an anime GIF.
    • Laugh button: Laugh, on your own or with someone, with an anime GIF.
    • Meme button: A random meme from Reddit (safe for work only), with a button for another.
  • /image: Fun picture edits of someone's avatar: Wanted poster, jail bars, RIP and more.
    • Wanted button: A Wanted poster with a coin reward, made from someone's avatar.
    • Jail button: Behind bars, made from someone's avatar.
    • Rip button: A gravestone, made from someone's avatar.
    • Wasted button: Grey, with WASTED across it, made from someone's avatar.
    • Pixel button: Turned into pixel art, made from someone's avatar.
  • /wheel: Spin a wheel of names to pick someone at random.

games.commands:
Commands

  • /bet: Casino games: blackjack, slots, roulette, dice, higher-or-lower, crash and the lottery.
    • Blackjack button: Play blackjack against the dealer: get closer to 21 than them without going over.
    • Slots button: Spin the slot machine. Three of a kind pays up to 77 times your bet.
    • Roulette button: Bet on a colour, odd or even, a dozen or one number, then spin the wheel.
    • Dice button: Bet on two dice landing over 7, under 7, exactly 7 or doubles.
    • Higher lower button: Guess if the next card is higher or lower to grow your pot, and cash out any time.
    • Crash button: Watch the multiplier climb and cash out before the rocket crashes.
    • Lottery button: Buy tickets for this server's weekly lottery. One ticket wins the whole pot.
  • /coinflip: Bet coins on heads or tails. Win and you double your bet, lose and it's gone.

music.commands:
Commands

  • /music: Play music from Spotify, SoundCloud or YouTube, with a player to control it.
    • Skip button: Skip the song that's playing.
    • Stop button: Stop the music, clear the queue and leave the voice channel.
    • Pause button: Pause or carry on with the song that's playing.
    • Queue button: See what's playing and what's next.
    • Loop button: Repeat the song that's playing, the whole queue, or nothing.
    • Volume button: Change the music volume, from 1 to 100.
    • Shuffle button: Shuffle the songs waiting in the queue.
    • Remove button: Take a song out of the queue by its number.
    • Play button: Play a song, a song by an artist, or a mix of an artist's songs. Links work too.
    • Playlist add button: Add the song that's playing, or a song you search for, to one of your playlists.
    • Playlist show button: See the songs in one of your playlists, or all your playlists.
    • Playlist play button: Play one of your playlists.
    • Playlist remove button: Take a song out of one of your playlists, by its number.
    • Playlist delete button: Delete one of your playlists.
    • History button: The songs that played most recently in this server.
